d:
Jharkhand vidhanasbha men SIR (Special Intensive Revision) ko lekar siyasi halchal tej ho gaee hai. mantri Radha Krishn Kishore ne sadan men SIR prakriya par rok lagane ka prastav pesh kiya hai. aakhir mantri ne sadan men kya dalil di? SIR ko lekar sarkar ka kya rukh hai aur is prastav ke bad jharkhand ki rajniti men kya naya mor aaega?
Dekhie is riport men puri khabra.
